title: Launch Commitments
creator: ManishModak / Outside_Taro_9886
summary: Rust token-factory template and CLI for fixed-supply, ownerless tokens with allocations locked through Ootle Lockbox until a chosen epoch. On November 12, Veil displayed the creator-linked publish receipt as RevealedCommit with network byte 0, epoch 38501, finalized at 04:48:44 UTC, and matching Launch Commitments template b18fc1ae…bcc9963. Lockbox’s current web configuration at ed3ff37 selects that mainnet template and a 2,500 TARI launch fee, with a separate Esmeralda configuration. Publication of the template is confirmed; no token launch or fee payment was performed here. Allocations remain locked until their epochs. Labels are creator-declared and do not establish team identity or ownership of the remaining supply. The existing November 12 recording remains a README walkthrough at bd8cf1f. Lockbox’s older README deployment table has not caught up with the current mainnet configuration and receipts. MIT source; template library 0.38. No wallet or third-party code was used.
cardSummary: Explore fixed-supply token launches that combine immutable issuer rules with epoch-based allocation locks through Ootle Lockbox.
publicationBasis: Public creator announcement in r/tari; creator describes a November MVP entry. Listing is not a contest eligibility or judging decision.
